faqs.q: What is the SI unit of energy?
faqs.a: The joule (J) — one newton-meter. Kilojoules and kilowatt-hours are the same physical quantity in different scales: 1 kWh = 3,600,000 J.
A food Calorie (capital C) is actually a kilocalorie: 1 kcal = 1,000 physics calories = 4,184 joules.

faqs.q: How many joules are in a BTU?
faqs.a: One British thermal unit (BTU) is defined as 1,055.05585262 joules — the energy to heat one pound of water by one degree Fahrenheit.
